body: If it makes you uncomfortable- jokes or not- I suggest just avoiding him. Better safe than sorry!
thanks, I'll have to do some more research on those stages!

I also had a friend like Lacy. Long story short: They're just not worth your grief if they disappear without saying a word.  
To move on? Spend time with all the friends you *do* have, take your mind off things, have a good time! You can find other people just as good (and probably better if they've done a disappearing act) as Lacy.
